languageModelTools.name: bcReport_inspectLayout
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Overview of an RDLC/RDL report layout (Business Central or SSRS): page setup with the blank-page check, datasets and their fields, parameters, Code block functions, embedded images, and the tree of report items with names, positions (in the report unit), values/expressions, table rows/columns/groups and the XML line range of every item. Call it first before changing a layout, and with `item` for all details (styles) of one item.

How to edit layouts: change simple properties directly in the XML file at the given lines – a textbox <Value>, <Style> children (FontWeight, FontSize, Color, Format, TextAlign, BackgroundColor, Border), <Visibility><Hidden>, <Top>/<Left>/<Width>/<Height>, <CanGrow>, the <Code> block, the dataset of a data region. Use the bcReport_* tools for structure: new items (bcReport_insertItems), table columns/rows/groups (bcReport_editTable), charts (bcReport_editChart), alignment/deleting (bcReport_arrangeItems), page size/margins/header/footer (bcReport_setPageLayout), AL columns/labels (bcReport_addAlColumns, bcReport_createAlLabel). Business Central regenerates <DataSets> and the label parameters from AL when building – do not edit those by hand. Run bcReport_validateLayout after editing.

file.description: Path of the .rdlc/.rdl layout (absolute or workspace-relative). Default: the layout open in the designer or the active editor.

item.description: Name of one report item to show with all details (styles, full values).

languageModelTools.name: bcReport_validateLayout
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Checks a layout: XML errors (with line), Fields!/Parameters!/ReportItems!/Code. references that do not exist (and drift against the AL report: columns not built yet or removed), duplicate item/group names, Fields! in the page header/footer, a body wider than the printable page (blank pages in PDF/print), items outside their section, expressions that cannot be parsed, and evaluation errors of the preview with sample data, plus Business Central hints (missing <Column>Format, fixed texts that should be labels). Run it after every direct XML edit and before you finish.

file.description: Path of the .rdlc/.rdl layout (absolute or workspace-relative). Default: the layout open in the designer or the active editor.

languageModelTools.name: bcReport_previewReport
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Renders the report with its preview data (the <layout>.data.json sidecar, else generated rows shaped like the AL dataset) and returns what the reader sees: textbox values, tables row by row (groups expanded, sorted, filtered, totals), charts as categories and series values, an unpaginated page header/footer snapshot, and evaluation errors. Use it to verify expressions, formats, grouping, visibility and totals after a change. Page breaks/pagination are not computed. Code/ReportItems in these snapshots may reflect the last document; verify per-page headers/footers in the paginated designer preview (bcReport_showInDesigner with mode preview). Number/date formatting follows the report Language, independently of the VS Code UI language. PageNumber/TotalPages in this snapshot are placeholders (1/1), never an actual page count; do not claim a page count or visually verified non-overlap from this output.

file.description: Path of the .rdlc/.rdl layout (absolute or workspace-relative). Default: the layout open in the designer or the active editor.

parameters.description: Report parameter values (name → value) for the preview.

maxRows.description: Maximum number of table rows in the output (default 60).

languageModelTools.name: bcReport_getReportData
languageModelTools.modelDescription: The Business Central side of a layout: the AL report or report extension using it with its data items and columns (marked whether the layout dataset has them yet), labels, caption parameters, the other layouts of the report and the preview data sidecar (<layout>.data.json – write it as JSON to test with realistic data). With `tableFieldsOf` (a data item name) it also lists the fields of that data item's table from the workspace and the symbol packages (.alpackages), i.e. what bcReport_addAlColumns can add. Use it to know which Fields!/Parameters! a layout can reference. AL LayoutFile paths are relative to the folder containing app.json, even when the AL source file is in src/.

file.description: Path of the .rdlc/.rdl layout (absolute or workspace-relative). Default: the layout open in the designer or the active editor.

tableFieldsOf.description: Name of a data item whose table fields to list. Use the AL data item identifier (for example Header), not its table name (for example Sales Invoice Header).

languageModelTools.name: bcReport_insertItems
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inserts report items with unique names and the XML structure the designer writes, following Business Central conventions: textbox; rectangle (a container, use its name as `parent` of further items); line; image (embedded from `imageFile`, or `value` = embedded image name / URL / expression); table (one column per entry of `fields`: header captions from <Field>Caption parameters, number formats from <Field>Format fields); matrix (row group × column group with a value); chart (`chart` with kind, category and series). Sizes are numbers in the report unit or strings with unit. Without `top` an item goes below the existing items of its container. A missing page header/footer is created. Prefer this over writing new items as XML; adjust details afterwards. Use parent for a textbox that must repeat inside an existing rectangle in a table/group (for example a Business Central document header); without parent it is a top-level section item and does not repeat with that group.

file.description: Path of the .rdlc/.rdl layout (absolute or workspace-relative). Default: the layout open in the designer or the active editor.

parent.description: Rectangle to insert into (position relative to it).

name.description: Item name (letters, digits, _; unique). Default: Textbox1, Tablix1 …

top.description: Top: a number in the report's unit or a string with unit ("2.5cm", "1in", "10pt", "5mm").

left.description: Left: a number in the report's unit or a string with unit ("2.5cm", "1in", "10pt", "5mm").

width.description: Width: a number in the report's unit or a string with unit ("2.5cm", "1in", "10pt", "5mm").

height.description: Height: a number in the report's unit or a string with unit ("2.5cm", "1in", "10pt", "5mm").

value.description: Textbox: text or expression (=Fields!X.Value, =Parameters!XLbl.Value, ="Page " & Globals!PageNumber). Image: embedded name, URL or expression.

style.description: RDL style values, e.g. {"FontWeight":"Bold","FontSize":"9pt","Color":"#1F4E79","TextAlign":"Right","Format":"N2","BackgroundColor":"LightGrey","BorderStyle":"Solid","BorderColor":"Black","BorderWidth":"1pt","PaddingLeft":"2pt"}. Values may be expressions. "" removes a value.

hidden.description: "true" or an expression that hides the item.

dataSet.description: Table/matrix/chart dataset (default: the first, in Business Central DataSet_Result).

fields.description: Table: dataset fields, one column each.

columns.description: Table without fields: number of empty columns.

category.description: Category grouping (x axis / slices), e.g. =Fields!Region.Value; "" for one category.

kind.description: Own chart kind in a combined chart

secondary.description: Plot against the secondary (right) value axis

dataLabels.description: Show values at the data points

format.description: Label format, e.g. N0, P0, C

imageFile.description: Image: PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/SVG file to embed (absolute or workspace-relative).

languageModelTools.name: bcReport_editChart
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads or changes a chart. Without `set` it returns the chart description (kind, dataset, category, series with value expressions, title, legend, palette, data labels, axes). With `set` it applies the given properties; `series` replaces the whole list (existing series keep their formatting, new ones are added like the last). Chart XML is long and deeply nested – use this tool instead of editing it, except for properties it does not cover.

file.description: Path of the .rdlc/.rdl layout (absolute or workspace-relative). Default: the layout open in the designer or the active editor.

category.description: Category grouping (x axis / slices), e.g. =Fields!Region.Value; "" for one category.

kind.description: Own chart kind in a combined chart

secondary.description: Plot against the secondary (right) value axis

dataLabels.description: Show values at the data points

format.description: Label format, e.g. N0, P0, C

languageModelTools.name: bcReport_arrangeItems
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Positions, aligns, sizes, orders or deletes report items, with unit conversion and section growth handled: `boxes` sets top/left/width/height per item; `align` aligns `items` to the first one; `sameSize` gives them the first one's width/height; `distribute` spaces 3+ items evenly; `center` centers them in their section/rectangle; `order` brings them to front/back; `delete` removes them (table cells are cleared). Items of align/size/distribute must share a container. Table cells are sized with bcReport_editTable.

file.description: Path of the .rdlc/.rdl layout (absolute or workspace-relative). Default: the layout open in the designer or the active editor.

items.description: Item names; the first is the reference for align/sameSize.

top.description: Top: a number in the report's unit or a string with unit ("2.5cm", "1in", "10pt", "5mm").

left.description: Left: a number in the report's unit or a string with unit ("2.5cm", "1in", "10pt", "5mm").

width.description: Width: a number in the report's unit or a string with unit ("2.5cm", "1in", "10pt", "5mm").

height.description: Height: a number in the report's unit or a string with unit ("2.5cm", "1in", "10pt", "5mm").

languageModelTools.name: bcReport_setPageLayout
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Page size and margins, body width/height, page header and footer (add/remove, height, print on first/last page) and the report unit (cm/in, changes only how sizes are written). `fitBodyToPage` sets the body to the printable width (page width minus left and right margins) – the fix for a blank page after every page. A4 portrait is 21cm × 29.7cm, landscape 29.7cm × 21cm; Letter 8.5in × 11in.

languageModelTools.name: bcReport_addAlColumns
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Adds columns to a data item of the AL report behind the layout (for a report extension inside an add() block), named by the Business Central convention <Field>_<DataItem> unless `name` is given. `field` is a field of the data item's table (checked against the workspace and symbols; bcReport_getReportData with tableFieldsOf lists them), `source` any AL expression. The layout can use them (=Fields!<Name>.Value) after a build (bcReport_buildProject). For other AL changes edit the .al file directly.

file.description: Path of the .rdlc/.rdl layout (absolute or workspace-relative). Default: the layout open in the designer or the active editor.

dataItem.description: Data item name as in AL, e.g. Header, Line.

source.description: AL expression instead of a field

languageModelTools.name: bcReport_createAlLabel
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a translatable label in the AL report (labels block; optional Comment for translators, MaxLength, Locked) and with `textbox` makes that textbox show it as =Parameters!<Label>.Value – both files in one undoable edit. Business Central layouts should use labels instead of fixed texts (validate reports those as "literal-text"). The name defaults to the base app convention (<Text>Lbl). AL edits stay in the undoable VS Code working copy until saved. Run bcReport_buildProject to save them and generate the layout parameters before checking on-disk AL or compiler output. For a new layout, first add its rendering/LayoutFile reference to the AL report; an unregistered RDLC has no AL target.

file.description: Path of the .rdlc/.rdl layout (absolute or workspace-relative). Default: the layout open in the designer or the active editor.

text.description: Label text in the app's base language.

textbox.description: Textbox (single text run) that should show the label.

languageModelTools.name: bcReport_renameColumn
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Renames a dataset column in AL and in all RDLC layouts of the report and its report extensions – field references, <Column>Format, <Column>Caption, the dataset declarations and textboxes named after the column – in one undoable edit. Never rename columns by search and replace.

file.description: Path of the .rdlc/.rdl layout (absolute or workspace-relative). Default: the layout open in the designer or the active editor.

languageModelTools.name: bcReport_buildProject
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Saves all files and runs "AL: Package" (Microsoft AL Language extension). The AL compiler regenerates the <DataSets> and label parameters of the RDLC layouts from the AL report – needed after adding AL columns or labels before the layout can use them without warnings. Check bcReport_validateLayout afterwards. Dirty AL documents without visible editor tabs are saved explicitly; a save failure stops the build. A returned tool result confirms the command ran, not that compilation succeeded: inspect AL diagnostics/output and revalidate the layout.

languageModelTools.name: bcReport_showInDesigner
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Opens the layout in the Report Builder designer for the user to see, optionally selects a report item and switches to the paginated preview. Use it at the end of a change so the user can review the result.

file.description: Path of the .rdlc/.rdl layout (absolute or workspace-relative). Default: the layout open in the designer or the active editor.
